Import the ASD-STE100 Issue 9 dictionary from one local PDF file

Usage: provenance dictionary import [OPTIONS] --pdf <PDF>

Options:
      --pdf <PDF>        Path to the local official Issue 9 PDF file
      --quiet            Drop the advisory notes commands print alongside their output, such as the warning that this repository has no shaping skills installed
      --repo <REPO>      [default: .]
      --format <FORMAT>  [default: json] [possible values: json]
  -h, --help             Print help
